description: Header file defining classes and interfaces for Android's Gralloc4 graphics buffer management, including mapper and allocator classes with methods for buffer handling, querying properties, and metadata management.

classes.name: Gralloc4Mapper
classes.description: Class providing buffer management and querying functionalities for graphics buffers using the V4_0 IMapper interface.

classes.name: Gralloc4Allocator
classes.description: Class responsible for allocating graphics buffers utilizing the Gralloc4Mapper.

methods.name: preload
methods.description: Static method to preload the mapper.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Checks if the mapper or allocator is loaded.

methods.name: dumpBuffer
methods.description: Returns a string dump of a specific buffer handle.

methods.name: dumpBuffers
methods.description: Returns a string dump of all buffers.

methods.name: importBuffer
methods.description: Imports a raw buffer handle into a buffer handle.

methods.name: validateBufferSize
methods.description: Validates the size of a buffer.

methods.name: getTransportSize
methods.description: Retrieves the transport size of a buffer.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks a buffer for access, providing data pointer and metadata.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks a buffer for YCbCr access.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if a buffer configuration is supported.

methods.name: getLayerCount
methods.description: Retrieves the number of layers in the buffer.

methods.name: getAllocationSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the buffer allocation.

methods.name: getProtectedContent
methods.description: Checks if buffer contains protected content.

methods.name: dumpDebugInfo
methods.description: Dumps debug info for the allocator.
